notes:
## New features & enhancements

- A Support block in Settings → Service, with a link to Ko-fi. Deskside Radio stays free; this is only for anyone who wants to chip in.
- After ten hours of listening, a small card in the corner says so, once. It never covers anything you are doing, and Don’t ask again means it.
- The Markticulous plate in the top bar now opens Settings at Service.
- Supporters can choose a small adornment to sit beside the Markticulous plate in the top bar.

## Bug fixes

- None in this release.
